lesson: FastAPI runs a sync dependency and the sync endpoint in different threadpool threads; a per-request sqlite3 connection needs check_same_thread=False or concurrent polling returns 500s. Unit tests with TestClient did not catch it; only e2e did.
LangChain create_agent ends the loop on an AIMessage with no tool calls, so a stub model's scripted reasoning text must ride on a tool-call message.
Default shell Node is v22; package.json engines require Node 26 — use ~/.nvm/versions/node/v26.x/bin on PATH before npm.
One-shot fetches written as `void api.x().then(...)` hide backend errors; prefer the polling hook or an explicit catch.
